title: multivitamin.json
description: Root metadata for a multivitamin catalog, read by the build that publishes manifest.json for multivitamin-web.

name.description: Short id, also the URL segment in multivitamin-web (e.g. rubyllm, terminal).

language.description: Language of the example sources (e.g. ruby, zsh).

grammar.description: Shiki grammar id used to highlight the sources (e.g. ruby, shellscript).

features.description: Feature folders under features/, in catalog order.
